sn44.8:1.1: atha kho vacchagotto paribbājako yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi
sn44.8:1.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho vacchagotto paribbājako bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn44.8:1.3: kiṃ nu kho bho gotama sassato lokoti.
sn44.8:1.4: abyākataṃ kho etaṃ vaccha mayā sassato lokoti …pe…
sn44.8:1.5: kiṃ pana bho gotama neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇāti.
